# convex-s3 (repository)

> The source of the npm package @cstack-dev/convex-s3, a Convex component for S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO). Import it as `@cstack-dev/convex-s3`.

- [Integration guide for coding agents](packages/convex-s3/llms.txt): install, bucket and IAM setup with the AWS CLI, the code to write, rules and pitfalls. Also shipped in the package: node_modules/@cstack-dev/convex-s3/llms.txt
- [Package README](packages/convex-s3/README.md): the user documentation and API reference.
- [Examples](packages/backend/convex): `files.ts` (uploads recorded in an app table) and `drive.ts` (a Google Drive clone where folders are S3 prefixes).
